blocking_findings.description: Unavailable typed motion context becomes a clean result. shape accepts a null dimension, and W1 checks only whether the contexts list is empty or contains the literal motion_plausibility dimension. A present observation with dimension=null satisfies neither condition. Independently queried an in-memory SQLite dataset containing matching media, decoded timeline, sampled-frame evidence and corrected record hashes: null and invalid dimensions each returned COMPLETE, ready=true, findings=[], unknown=[]. The valid motion dimension produced W1. Thus unavailable context is treated as successful evaluation.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Validate the dimension needed to determine W1 applicability before treating the context as available. Null, missing or invalid context must produce UNKNOWN or an integrity failure. Add direct and retained-query regressions with explicit diagnostics and ready=false, preserving valid non-motion behavior.

blocking_findings.description: E3 treats the existence of a metadata object as an available decoded timeline without validating its duration. For full-clip evidence with no explicit interval or samples, the comparisons never execute. Independently queried a retained TEST-ONLY graph after replacing metadata.duration_seconds with null, then an invalid string, and updating its digest. Both queries returned COMPLETE, ready=true, findings=[], unknown=[]. The promised unavailable-timeline boundary is bypassed.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Check that the decoded timeline context is usable before evaluating evidence bounds, including when evidence has no explicit coordinates. Return UNKNOWN or an integrity failure for unavailable or invalid duration. Add direct and retained-query regressions for full-clip evidence and malformed timeline context.
